ND-2025-HB1168.aiSummary: The bill would change how North Dakota handles some state money and property tax rules. It would create new funds for legacy earnings and property tax relief, add a way to certify a primary home, and set limits on some property tax increases unless voters approve them. It would also update rules for homestead tax credits, renters refunds, disabled veteran tax credits, school district levies, and property tax notices.
